fixed_findings: Unsupported star and symbolic ALT alleles no longer abort a mixed SpliceAI classifier batch; they remain visible as not_scored.
Overlapping SpliceAI annotations are reported as top_score_gene and annotated_genes, preventing a highest-score annotation from being misrepresented as the selected clinical transcript.
The CFTR extended-window counterexample, concordant false-positive limitation, CPU torch guidance, long-key warning bound, and BPHunter availability limitation are explicit.
residual_limitations: Branchpoint tools with unavailable or unverified installs are not presented as runnable workflows.
SpliceTransformer and CI-SpliceAI remain optional heavyweight tools; their external weights and installation provenance must be recorded per analysis.
score_rationale: Production Ready reflects the corrected executable primary workflow and executed real SpliceAI regression. The score is not higher because optional external predictors remain environment-heavy and this audit is non-independent.
